key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: Time in minutes between background polling of GitHub PR data.

key.name: include-repos
key.description: Comma-separated list of repo names or patterns (e.g. 'canonical/*', 'user/repo'). If empty, all accessible repos are included.

key.name: exclude-repos
key.description: Comma-separated list of repository names or patterns to ignore.

key.name: ignore-archived
key.description: Whether to exclude PRs belonging to archived repositories.

key.name: ignore-forks
key.description: Whether to exclude PRs belonging to fork repositories.

key.name: last-username
key.description: Cached login of the authenticated GitHub account.
